INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.

2. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.

   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

6. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose
